title: Allow the configured Sentry ingest origin through the enforced browser policy

source.ref: Anonymous production browser audit CSP violation, 2026-10-23

detail: Production browser reported Sentry envelope requests blocked by connect-src: the client SDK was configured but the enforced policy omitted its ingest origin. Derive the exact HTTPS origin from the same public/server DSN fallback as the SDK; include only that origin, without userinfo, project path or vendor wildcard. Malformed or non-HTTPS values add nothing. A real config.headers() regression failed before repair; focused telemetry, CSP and instrumentation batch passes 91 tests in seven suites, with a final 13-test CSP rerun after mock isolation. A standalone low-cost probe evaluates actual config declarations and the actual pure helper without loading the build plugin or spawning another runner. Existing Stripe hosts, object/base/frame restrictions and production eval exclusion remain tested. No synthetic event was sent to production Sentry; provider ingestion acceptance remains unproven until deployment and controlled validation. Official Sentry CSP guidance confirms the configured regional ingest endpoint is the required connection source.

verify.note: Evaluate the real CSP assembly against configured regional/self-hosted HTTPS endpoints and absent/malformed/HTTP configuration; reject credentials/path/wildcard leakage and preserve production restrictions.
